Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye

No recent history of eye trauma

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with sudden, unilateral loss of vision.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—I'm a 60-year-old woman. About 30 minutes ago, I suddenly and painlessly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV, and my left eye seems unaffected.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing a sudden and strong need to urinate, even when your bladder isn't full?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I've not noticed any sudden or strong need to urinate, and I haven’t had that kind of urgency when my bladder isn’t full.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or mass in your breast that you can feel when you touch it?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t felt any firm lump or mass in either breast, and I haven’t noticed any new breast changes when I check.”

turns.doctor_question: you noticed any small, smooth, and firm bumps on your skin, like little raised spots that don't seem to be painful or it
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any small, smooth, firm bumps on my skin—no little raised spots that are painless like that.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling about your body temperature lately? Do you find that you're having trouble cooling down or feeling like you're overheating, even when you're in a cool environment?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—my body temperature feels normal; I’m not overheating or having trouble cooling down, and I haven’t felt feverish.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’ve been feeling pretty normal and I’m not having unusual stress or anxiety lately.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a strong urge to scratch your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any itching or a strong urge to scratch my skin lately. Other than the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye about 30 minutes ago, I haven’t noticed anything like that.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions on your arms, particularly along the veins?
turns.patient_answer: “No doctor, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions on my arms—especially nothing along the veins. Aside from the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye, I haven’t had any new skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that it's been harder for you to find the right words when you're talking or thinking? Sometimes, do you feel like the words you're looking for are just on the tip of your tongue, but you can't quite get them out?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any trouble finding words or any difficulty thinking; my speech and understanding feel normal to me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, making it difficult to move or relax?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in my muscles, and I can move and relax normally. The main thing is still the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: 's your energy level been today? Have you felt unusually sleepy or struggled to stay awake, even when you were doing things you normally enjoy or needed to focus
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, my energy level has been normal—I haven’t felt unusually sleepy or had trouble staying awake, and I could focus normally aside from the sudden painless vision loss in my right eye.”

turns.doctor_question: How are your legs feeling in terms of temperature? Do they feel warm to you?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, my legs feel normal—neither unusually warm nor cold to me. I haven’t noticed any difference in temperature in my legs.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find that you're coughing up mucus or phlegm when you cough?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I’m not coughing up any mucus or phlegm, and I haven’t had any recent cough. My only concern is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rough, scaly patches on your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any rough, scaly patches on my skin or any new rashes. My only symptom has been the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago, with my left eye unaffected.”
